Jennifer Lawrence brought up her new breast implants and revealed details on “Watch What Happens Live” Thursday, drawing multiple compliments from host Andy Cohen.

The Oscar winner, who was on the show to promote the “Hunger Games” prequel “Sunrise on the Reaping,” got personal when Cohen mentioned that a newcomer to the “Real Housewives of New York City” series said her nose was broken by a lover’s large breasts.

“Is it a mystery to you how a boob could break Hailey Glassman’s nose?” Cohen, 58, asked.

“Yes, and I have implants,” Lawrence said.

“You do?” Cohen asked.

“Yeah, they’re new,” she said, even giving a plug for the doctor who did the work.

“Really? They’re beautiful!” Cohen said.

“Are those Bs?” Cohen asked, as if this were standard talk show conversation.

“No, it’s a full C. I think?” Lawrence answered. “It’s the same size that they were.”

“They’re beautiful,” Cohen said. “I appreciate your restraint.”

“Anyway, I’ve broken two noses,” Lawrence joked.

The 36-year-old “No Hard Feelings” star, who has two children with husband Cooke Maroney, confirmed last month that she underwent enhancement surgery.

“I want to be a sexy mom,” she said. “At drop-off, I want to look like a woman that has her shit together even when I’ve just woken up and don’t have my shit together.”
